[*] Nova Hurricane attachment 3 - HP of nova before split increased 15 HP to 20 HP.
[*] Lance Rapide Attachment 2 - Damage from 0 to 10 p/s.

[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where your body would occasionally point straight ahead at the start of matches.
[*] Fixed an issue where Super Majestic shots would not make a sound near you.
[*] Fixed minor errors for Russian and Traditional Chinese localizations.

notes.title: Blaston: Free-To-Play Patch is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we have released a patch for Blaston to address some issues introduced in version 2.0 of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/f71883f3546c14fdfd80df899fe24104916da2d8.png[/img]

These mainly focus on critical issues found where players were unable to see their equipped avatar skins in the Ozo Lounge as well as text not being displayed properly for players playing Blaston in Italian & Traditional Chinese.

In version 2.0 we had hoped to add more localization options for players, but unfortunately we ran into issues when adding Italian and Traditional Chinese to the game. For the time being these options will become unavailable, and we hope to be able to add them into the game in a future update.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Avatar skins are now properly displayed when entering the Ozo Lounge.
[*] Updated and fixed several text errors in weapon and attachment descriptions.
[*] Disabled broken unsupported languages: Italian & Traditional Chinese.
[/list]

For players on standalone Quest 1, unfortunately it seems like the game is having trouble running the game with all the new content added in. We’re currently investigating this issue to see what we can do to solve the problem.

If you’re running the game on Quest 1, we recommend you restart the headset, and avoid entering the Ozo Lounge for now. You should still be able to play duels normally while we investigate this further. For Quest 1 players on Steam, you should still be able to play the game as per usual.

notes.title: The Blaston: Free To Play Update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=XpMd7DqeWzQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Blaston is now a Free-To-Play game![/b] Welcome to the Free-To-Play Update, we have a lot of things that we included in the game which brings the version number to 2.0! We hope you’re as excited as we are about what’s ahead for the game. Read the highlights below, or check out the patch notes list further down for a quicker overview.

[h2]Blaston is now Free-To-Play![/h2]
On Steam and Meta Quest, Blaston is now a free to play title. This means that you no longer need to purchase the game to get in on the action. Let your friends know and start playing today!

[h2]Golden Gratitude Reward[/h2]
We’re incredibly thankful for everyone that has supported Blaston so far, it’s you who have allowed us to get to this point and have kept the game alive. As a thank you for believing in us, and purchasing the game before it went free to play - you will all recieve the Golden Gratitude Reward. This includes the Golden Gratitude skin for Clamos & the Viper Ellipse, as well as a x1 Wall of Blasts (1160 Blasts) for free! Explore the new store and pick out something special with your new chunk of change. This skin pack will first be available for our veteran supporters, and will be available at a later point in the store for everyone else.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/39f193f212cb7d146e2cf77c6cadf428aa638a2b.png[/img]

[h2]Blaston is coming to Pico![/h2]
Blaston is not only going free to play on Steam and Meta Quest, as the game will be available on Pico 3 & 4 devices starting early 2023. We’re currently finishing up the final pieces, but soon you’ll all be able to join the action from 3 VR platforms!

[h2]New Legendary Skin Set: Dynasty[/h2]
The Dynasty Bots guard VIPs within the Premium version of the Paracosm. Made for high impact and high performance to take any and all threats down. You can now find the Dynasty skin for both the Octo Agent, and the Wildcat.

[h2]New Legendary Podium: Bliss[/h2]
Show your true allegiance to the game with this newly animated podium which sports the “NEVER. STAY. STILL.” slogan!

[h2]New Avatar & Weapon Skins:[/h2]
Aside from the legendary skins, we have a ton of skins for both avatars and weapons. You’ll be able to find them in the newly remodeled store in the main menu. Enjoy!

[h2]New Attachments: Majestic, Supermajestic, Majestic Nade, Avalanche Nade, Swarm, Tundra, Nova Nade, Lance Rapide[/h2]
We’ve added 3 attachments each for 8 more weapons in this update including all of the enercage weapons, but also the special weapons Swarm & Tundra as well as the Nova Nade and Lance Rapide. We’re hoping to bring back enercages into the mix and reintroduce the area denial tools for you to use.

[h2]New Movement System:[/h2]
We’ve completely reworked the movement system (Inverse Kinematics) for the avatars in the game to be more realistic and follow your natural body movements. For advanced users of Blaston this means that you’ll now have to move as you would in real life to dodge and avoid incoming projectiles. Our main reasonings for this huge change is to continue to promote movement in the game, lessen any confusion as to why you got hit and also avoid having players doing unnatural movements that could lead to injuries. This will take some time for veteran players to get used to, but we hope you look forward to using the new system.

[h2]New Features in the Blaston Spectator:
[/h2]The free to use [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952470/Blaston_Spectator/]Blaston Spectator[/url] has now been updated to 2.0 with a few new additions to optimize use for continued tournament use. We’ve tweaked the in-game UI, added localization to the client, a camera speed option along with a freecam mode. To fully capture some cinematic shots you can now also toggle the UI in-game with the “U” button.

[h3]Game Updates:[/h3]
[list][*] Blaston is now Free-To-Play on Meta Quest & Steam.
[*] Remodeled the Store in the Main Menu.
[*] Remodeled the Customization screen in the Main Menu.
[*] Added new avatar & weapon skins to the store.
[*] Added a new podium to the store.
[*] Added attachments for: Majestic, Supermajestic, Majestic Nade, Avalanche Nade, Swarm, Tundra, Nova Nade, Lance Rapide.
[*] Updated and balanced the weapons in the game.
[*] Improved the Passthrough Mode on Quest 2
[*] Added Color Passthrough Mode on Quest Pro.
[*] Updated the game movement system (Inverse Kinematics).
[*] Added several new loadouts to the Arctic Blast game mode.[/list]
[h3]Weapon Updates & Balancing:[/h3]
[list][*] Hammer Attachment 2: Increased collision damage from 14 to 15.
[*] Hammer Attachment 3: Reduced projectile speed slightly.
[*] Hammer Ellipse Attachment 3: Decreased damage.
[*] Hurricane Attachment 1: Reduced player damage from 14 to 10.

[*] Lance Attachment 3: Reduced damage per second.
[*] Lance Rapide: Reduced damage per second.
[*] Luma: Reload increased from 0.3s to 0.5s.
[*] Luma Attachment 1: Reload increased from 0.3s to 0.5s.
[*] Luma Attachment 2: Reload increased from 0.3s to 0.5s.
[*] Luma Attachment 3: Reload increased from 0.3s to 0.5s.
[*] Nova Attachment 1: Increased projectile speed from 0.7 to 1.
[*] Nova Hurricane: Decreased the strength of gravity of projectiles, now acts more like the regular Hurricane. 
[*] Raptor Attachment 1: Increased player damage from 5 to 6.
[*] Viper Attachment 2: Player damage decreased from 25 to 20, added +1 projectile bounce, reduced speed.
[*] Wildcat Attachment 1: Reduced burst of projectiles.
[*] Wildcat Attachment 2: Decreased projectile spread, increased collision damage to 8.[/list]
[h3]Attachment Additions:[/h3]
[list][*] Avalanche Nade Attachment 1: Fewer but faster projectiles
[*] Avalanche Nade Attachment 2: Less projectiles with a tighter spread.
[*] Avalanche Nade Attachment 3: Delayed fire on projectiles with larger spread.

[*] Lance Rapide Attachment 3: 4 shots with increased damage per second but reduced duration
[*] Majestic Attachment 1: Decreases projectile size and duration, but increases speed and damage.

[*] Tundra Attachment 3: Split projectiles with reduced ammo and reduced damage.[/list]
[h3]Ranked Changes:[/h3]
[list][*] Players above the Platinum rank have now had their rank reset to Platinum.[/list]
[h3]Other Updates:[/h3]
[list][*] Adjusted the single player campaign to be easier for new players to take on. 
[*] Added a social contract for when entering the Ozo Lounge the first time. Remember that you can block and mute someone if someone misbehaves which will remove them from your social area.
[*] Adjusted the menu position when accessing the tools loadout to be more to the left, allowing players to more easily practice ellipse weapons from the left.
[*] Prices of legendary items have been adjusted.[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Hurricane Attachment 1 would display incorrect player damage numbers.[/list]
[h3]Blaston Spectator:[/h3]
[list][*] Added localization support.
[*] Added localization option in settings.
[*] Added a camera speed option in settings.
[*] Added a freecam mode option in settings.
[*] Added a UI toggle accessed with “U”.
[*] Optimized In-Game UI.[/list]

Thank you for supporting Blaston to allow us to get to this point!

Keep in mind that if you’d like to suggest something for the game, we have[url=https://resolutiongames.canny.io/blaston] the Blaston suggestion board[/url] specifically for this! While we can’t promise any changes, posting here helps us understand what the community would like to see in Blaston.

Of course, if you’d like to meet and discuss the game with us and others, then you can also join the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Blaston/]Blaston Reddit[/url] and the [url=https://discord.gg/Blaston]Blaston Discord[/url]!

To keep yourself updated on the game, we suggest you also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BlastonGame]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.facebook.com/BlastonGame/]Facebook[/url]!

If you're interested in competing in Blaston you can follow our official partner VRML on [url=https://twitter.com/Blaston_VRML]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.twitch.tv/blaston_vrml]Twitch[/url].

- The Blaston Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/dc51b14fcf3580ef84ff9b03004bfc9d61b5b5f7.png[/img]

Have you missed us? We haven't posted a roadmap for the game in a while, but we're finally ready to talk a bit more about the next update for Blaston.

With the Glow Up update now out for a few months alongside the Blaston Championship, we've gathered a ton of learnings when it comes to the state of the game and what type of content that you as a player value. In our next update we're going to focus on these key areas, while also making the game more accessible than ever.

[*] 🔫 Weapon balance changes
[*] 👑 Ranked improvements

By now you've come to expect new attachments with updates, and this will not slow down with our next update. With the extended period that we've had, we've also been able to see the meta change and stabilize which will make it easier for us to decide on how to move forward when adding more of them as well as balancing the weapons overall.

With the attachments and balance changes, we'll also continue to introduce more options for players to be able to show off their styles within the game.

We've noted several core parts in the game that we would like to dive deeper into which are the ranked system and the store. Overall we're hoping to make this the best version of Blaston yet, balance wise, but also introduction wise for new players to get into and stick with the game. notes.title: The Blaston: Glow Up Update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/5edba2669caa4e58d4a52f64c39a267f4bf90802.png[/img]

We’re BACK! And we have a bunch of content added to the game for you. In the Glow Up update, we’ve included several new skins, avatars, a new arena - along with new attachments and weapon balancing - and the launch of the Blaston Championship!

[h2]New Legendary Skin: Lyxx[/h2]
Lyxx has always been the face of Blaston, and today we’re switching it up by giving her a new look with a legendary demonic skin. With a more aggressive look, we see this as an alter ego to the main character that you know and love!

[h2]New Avatars: Clamos & Argentia[/h2]
A little over a year ago we launched the singleplayer campaign for the game, and we know you want to be able to become the characters that you face. So we polished the models and made them av	ailable to be played. Get them in the store now.

[h2]New Arena: Greatstone Valley[/h2]
Similarly to the campaign characters, a lot of people expressed how they missed playing Quick Draw when it fell out of the seasonal mode. Well, now you’ll at least be able to go halfway there with a classic version of Greatstone Valley.

[h2]New Attachments: Ellipse Weapons, Vector, Nova Helix, Nova Hurricane, & Lance Nade[/h2]
Last update, we brought a new element into the meta with several attachments including bouncing projectiles. This time we’re shifting our focus to the original ellipse weapons, along with weapons we felt like needed some love with the Vector, Nova Helix, Nova Hurricane & Lance Nade. You can now track and complete the attachment missions for these to find new ways to play with them!

[h2]New Tournament Circuit: Blaston Championship 2022[/h2]
Alongside the Glow Up update, we’re launching our first ever competitive circuit for Blaston! If you’ve ever wanted to try competition in the game, now’s your chance. The circuit is divided into 3 phases, with the first starting this August. Players can join by playing the ranked mode, joining the weekly Blastzone Challenges, or participating in community tournaments to fight for their lion share of a total of $11,000 prize pool! Read more on the official webpage at: [b][url=https://www.resolutiongames.com/blaston/championship]resolutiongames.com/blaston/championship[/url][/b]

[h2]Blaston Championship Cosmetics: Banners & Universal Weapon Skin[/h2]
With the launch of the Blaston Championship, we’re adding a few more cosmetics to the game so that you can fully get into the competitive spirit. You’ll now see the Blaston Championship logo in the arenas, and you can also represent your region with the European or North American banners available in the store. notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/3292c5c490e0e0a8da827bcede7f42031f688fda.png[/img]

[h2][b]We’re back with another roadmap post for Blaston![/b][/h2]

Now that Reloaded has been out for a while and we’ve managed to smash most bugs in the subsequent patches, let’s take a look forward at what’s coming in the next Blaston update.

[b]Currently Planned Content & Events:[/b]
[list][*] 🔨 General Bug Fixes
[*] 🤖 New Avatars
[*] 😼 Legendary Avatar Skin
[*] 🎨 More Skins
[*] 🔫 More Weapon Attachments
[*] 🏆 Championship Tournament[/list]
Starting off you may notice that we’re not pointing out new core game features, and that’s because in this update we’ll focus more on content for the game. We’ve heard you loud and clear and we know that you want more customization options for your in-game avatars. So you’ll see some new ones, along with some that you may have run into in the past as well…

We’re also going to continue the rollout of attachments in the next update, as well as further weapons balancing. We appreciate the feedback that has been given, and thanks to your play, we have the information we need to make the game’s balancing even better.

We’ve also noted a few crucial bugs that we haven’t been able to get to yet that we’ll be looking to address in the next update. We want to remind everyone that if you run into a bug, it helps us a ton if you follow the instructions in the discord and report them properly. If we get a bug report without visuals, reporting ID, or any reproduction steps, it significantly lowers the chance of us finding the problem and fixing it for you. So help us help you if you find any!

Finally, for those with keen eyes, you may remember that we had a very specific picture chosen for this update back in January when we did our 2022 roadmap video. Just know that we’re working on something big. It will be the first Blaston tournament of its kind, and we hope to see as many of you participating in it as possible! So stay tuned for that as the details will roll out alongside the update.

[b]So with that said, what are you looking forward to the most? 👀[/b]
If you haven't already, join the [url=https://discord.gg/blaston]Blaston Discord[/url] to talk to other players about it!

We hope that you’re enjoying the Blaston: Reloaded update! With the update, we’ve noted several issues along with some very strong weapons and attachments. We’ve fixed several of these issues along with adjusting some of the weapons to accommodate this in version 1.16.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed instances where players would get stuck in a lobby after playing consecutive matches in the Ozo Lounge.
[*] Fixed instances where several attachments would get unlocked and tracked at the same time.
[*] Attachment mission updates in the main menu are now more frequent to show the progress more clearly.
[*] Fixed instances where fog would be shown unintentionally in some environments.
[*] Fixed instances where players would have their regular loadout in a Street Brawl match.
[*] Fixed instances where attachments would be equipped on a weapon before being unlocked.
[*] Improved frame rates during matches.
[*] Fixed instances where projectiles would not disappear leading to worsen framerates. Players who encounter this are advised to report this in settings after the match happens.
[*] Fixed instances where weapons would get stuck to a player's hand.
[*] Disabled faulty ping indicators showing in match replays.
[*] Fixed instances where the enercages from Avalanche Nade, Majestic and Super Majestic would be very loud when dealing damage.
[*] Fixed an instance which switched the Nova cooldown to be 2 instead of 7 when equipping the Attachment 3.
[/list]
[h1]Weapon Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Cortex Shield[/b]: Collision hitbox adjusted to match model.
[*] [b]Frostbyte: [i]Attachment 3[/i][/b] - Max speed from 4.5 to 3.8.
[*] [b]Hammer Nade: [i]Attachment 1[/i][/b] - Projectiles are now slightly faster.
[*] [b]Lance: [i]Attachment 1[/i][/b] - Damage increased, attachment 3 damage reduced.
[*] [b]Luma [/b]- Collision from 30 to 50 down to 15 to 25.
[*] [b]Luma: [i]Attachment 3[/i][/b] - Reduced projectiles on full strength from 3 to 2.
[*] [b]Nova: [i]Attachment 3[/i][/b] - Changed stats - HP 65, Collision 55, damage 25.
[*] [b]Raptor: [i]Attachment 2[/i][/b] - reload time increased from 0.2 to 0.4.
[*] [b]Street Brawl Luma[/b]: Can now pop street brawl nova with two shots.
[*] [b]Viper: [i]Attachment 2[/i][/b] - Fixed bug of spawn cost from 2 to 5. Reduced damage from 30 to 25.
[*] [b]Vector[/b]: Ammo reduced from 3 to 2.
[/list]

If you didn't catch the update patch notes for the Blaston: Reloaded update, [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/developer-post/318017220413081/]you can read them here![/url]

notes.title: Blaston: Reloaded Update is live!
notes.content:
[b]It’s time to get down to brass tacks, because the Blaston Reloaded Update is finally here![/b] Version 1.15 brings the long awaited first batch of weapon attachments to the game, a new seasonal mode “Street Brawl”, and our first collaboration weapon item “The Cyber Bow”.

And that’s not all, we’ve continued to work on quality of life features for the game as well, along with some new rewards and legendary skins for weapons and avatars! This is probably our biggest update to date, so gear up, get ready, and load into Blaston Reloaded!

[h2]New Weapon Feature: Weapon Attachments[/h2]
We’ve now added weapon attachments to the game. We’re starting with 10 weapons to make sure that we maintain the balance of the overall weapons in the game. In the first batch we’re including 3 attachments to the following weapons: Raptor, Nova, Wildcat, Hammer, Viper, Lance, Hammer Nade, Frostbyte, Hurricane and Luma.

Attachments are unlocked by the new mastery system, select a weapon in the loadout and press “track” to begin the mastery. Complete the missions to unlock the attachments one by one, then equip them to change the behavior of the weapon!

[h3]New Seasonal Game Mode: Street Brawl[/h3]
It’s time to take things to the streets, the Scrappers’ Street to be more specific! In the new seasonal game mode, duelists play in long distance duels using The Cyber Bow and a modified Nova to take each other down. Who’s the best dodger and marksman? Settle the score with a Street Brawl!

[h3]New Weapon: Luma[/h3]
Introducing the first two-handed weapon to the world of Blaston is the Luma! This is a sharpshooter bow and arrow where duelists will have to give up an extra hand for some extreme damage output!

[h3]The Blaston Spectator will be available for free on Steam on May 5th[/h3]
Soon after this update, we’re releasing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952470/Blaston_Spectator/]Blaston Spectator[/url] on Steam for free! This is a separate version of Blaston where you can spectate matches on a PC. This is mainly built for content creators and tournament organizers, but anyone can try it out and watch their matches from new camera angles including third person and first person views!

[h3]New Weapon Skins: The Karnivore, The Mallet & The Cyber Bow[/h3]
Take charge with the new legendary versions of the Hammer Ellipse and Raptor Ellipse. The Mallet replaces the Hammer Ellipse and represents a darker more feared version, as it dons the b0yk0t logo on the side. Joining it is the Karnivore, which like the Deadringer, represents a look reminding players of the past worlds of Blaston. Both of them are now available in the store for all players.

The collaboration item skin for the Luma, from Apex Construct, The Cyber Bow is now here in Blaston. It’s unknown how the item first appeared in the world of Blaston, it’s assumed a glitch in the system may have brought it forth from another virtual world. Try it out in the Street Brawl seasonal mode, and get it for free in the store within the release week of the Blaston Reloaded Update. Along with the the collaboration, we also have a bundle to get both Blaston and Apex Construct! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25524]Get the bundle here![/url]

[h3]New Legendary Avatar Skin: Bunny Hax[/h3]
The hologram face upgrade is no longer unique to Shoxx! The newest skin for Hax, Bunny Hax, gives the avatar this feature as well along with some very tall bunny ears.

[h3]New Cosmetics: Blaston VR Master League Platform & Banner[/h3]
We have partnered up with VR Master League (VRML) to bring you the first official esports league of Blaston, built together with the community. Get the VRML banners in the store, or get them by signing up to Blaston VRML Season 1: [url=https://vrmasterleague.com/blaston]vrml.com/blaston[/url]

[h3]New Arena: Scrappers’ Street[/h3]
Some fights are just not meant to be displayed in fancy arenas, some fights you settle in the streets. Now you’re able to challenge others in the Scrappers’ Street arena by purchasing it in the store!

[h3]Graphical Improvements[/h3]
We’ve taken some time to look into the performance and visuals of the game, and it has paid off! You’ll notice that the locker room in the main menu has been cleaned up, but we’ve also made sure to optimize the textures of the game, along with making improvements to banners. We’ve also changed filtering settings for the game which will make it look a bit clearer. For players on Quest devices, we’ve also made some improvements in the passthrough mode by adding particles and fixing some color issues.

[h3]Community Request: Ping Indicator[/h3]
We’ve heard the calls from the community, you want to get a better understanding of the quality of the matches. We’ve responded to this by introducing a ping indicator to the match interface to allow players to identify the quality and stability of their connection to the match. Our hope is that this will give players an idea if they need to improve things on their end, and also for tournament organizers to more properly host competitive events.

[h3]Community Request: Wait for an opponent[/h3]
Many players have told us that they would like to still be able to access the main menu and loadout while waiting for a match. Now players are able to do so by going into the duel settings, and select “Wait for an opponent”. Enabling this option allows players to check their loadout and practice combos on the dummy bot before heading into a match.

[h2]Game Updates[/h2]
[list][*] New seasonal game mode added: Street Brawl
[*] New weapon added: Luma
[*] New legendary skins added to: Raptor Ellipse, Hammer Ellipse
[*] New legendary avatar skin added: Bunny Hax
[*] New cosmetics added: VRML Platform & Banner
[*] New arena added: Scrappers’ Street
[*] Main menu environment has been updated.
[*] Ping indicators have been added to the match UI.
[*] Duel option “Wait for an opponent” added to duel settings.
[*] (Meta) Particles and effects have been added to passthrough mode.
[*] Optimized textures on all platforms.
[*] Updated the tutorial to include dodging & out of bounds steps.
[*] Updated introduction information panels.
[*] Legendary weapon skins have now been added to the store.
[*] New bots have been added for players with over 2000 League Points.[/list]

[h2]Campaign Updates[/h2]
[list][*] Campaign bots no longer have a single type of weapon.
[*] Players now have access to more weapons in the campaign.
[*] Campaign opponents now act more like ranked bots and will dodge projectiles.
[*] Some Ozo Missions have now been removed from the campaign.
[*] Match versus Argentia has now been improved.
[*] ModOps skins now have the text “ModOps” on them in the store.[/list]

[h2]Weapon Updates[/h2]
[list][*] Weapons are now trackable to unlock in batches at level 5, 10 and 15.
[*] Once a weapon is trackable, track it in the loadout menu and complete the 3 weapon missions to unlock the weapon.
[*] Once the weapon is unlocked, if the weapon has attachments, equip and track the weapon then complete the attachment missions to unlock attachments for the weapon.
[*] Added attachment missions and 3 attachments (each) to: Raptor, Nova, Wildcat, Hammer, Viper, Lance, Hammer Nade, Frostbyte, Hurricane and Luma.
[*] Adapted the firing speed of all projectiles to be linear instead of having an initial speed burst to combat visual inconsistencies during high latency matches.
[*] [b]Avalanche Nade[/b]: Projectiles reduced by 2, reduced spread.
[*] [b]Cortex Shield[/b]: Hit points increased from 80 to 100, cost reduced from 6 to 5, size increased slightly.
[*] [b]Hammer[/b]: Added weapon charge VFX & SFX.
[*] [b]Majestic[/b]: Duration increased from 5 to 7, size radius reduced from 0.18 to 0.07.
[*] [b]Nova Helix[/b]: Reloadtime reduced from 0.8 to 0.6, speed reduced from 0.8 to 0.3 with tighter rotation pathing.
[*] [b]Nova Hurricane[/b]: Reload time reduced from 0.8 to 0.6.
[*] [b]Swarm[/b]: Swarm Node HP from 3 (uncharged) 5 (charged), to 15 (uncharged) -> 20 (charged).
[*] [b]Tundra[/b]: Charge time reduced from 0.5 to 0.3, cost reduced from 6 to 4. Added weapon charge VFX.
[*] [b]Vector[/b]: Ammo reduced from 6 ammo to 2 bursts of 3, reload time increased from 0.2 to 0.6.[/list]

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]
[list][*] Mission rewards now give you significant Blasts instead of specific items.
[*] Updated the main menu UI & improved edges of visuals.
[*] Legendary weapons skins have been added to the store.
[*] Updated the model scaling of the player banners.
[*] Added the ability to create friendly lobbies with all seasonal modes.
[*] (Quest) Added Destinations for all seasonal modes.
[*] (Steam) Added the ability to bind joysticks to scroll in menus.
[*] Added hyperlinks to News, now you can click links there!
[*] Added VRML logotype to the arena rinks.
[*] Updated the music of the main menu.
[*] Updated LIV camera angles for Quick Draw & Street Brawl.
[*] Added tooltip explaining the cooldown limit of loadouts.
[*] Color wheel in Ozo is now lit up.
[*] Updated the texture of the Wildcat.
[*] Updated localization and grammar in the shop.
[*] Updated the FAQ button link in the news tab.[/list]

[h2]Ranked Changes[/h2]
[list][*] Added a ranked season cooldown at the start & end of each season to improve leaderboard resets.
[*] Rank decay is now enabled for players with over 1900 League Points (previously over 1700).
[*] If you do not login for 1 week, your rank will be decayed by 5 League Points (previously 10) once per day.
[*] Bot rewards in ranked are now enabled up to 2600 League Points.[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the colors would look weird in passthrough mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where the weapon trails weren’t displaying properly for the Viper Ellipse & Hammer Ellipse.
[*] Fixed a few instances where matchmaking would time out when players are matched from different regions.
[*] Fixed instances where the cheer sound effect in friendly lobbies would continue to play after a rematch is initiated.
[*] Fixed an issue where the shield handles would spawn in an incorrect rotation angle.
[*] Fixed an issue where the red highlight on health bars wouldn’t show for both players.[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update!
- The Blaston Team

notes.title: Blaston: Reloaded Update Devlog #2 - Quality Of Life Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Hi there Blasters![/b] Today we wanted to give you a sneak peak at some of the things we're adding to the Blaston: Reloaded Update! In this one we're taking a look at Quality of Life Improvements! [b]Watch the video below to get the information, or read the text version here below.[/b]

[previewyoutube=FA1tRimjaQI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Campaign Updates[/h1]
Starting off, this one is for new players and the lore fans out there, we’re taking another look at the singleplayer campaign and making some adjustments to it. Players will now have a larger set of weapons to get to know the game with, and we’re making the battles a bit more interactive with bots reacting more like they would in regular matches. We’ve also removed some unwanted missions forcing players to go to the Ozo Lounge, and added some improvements to the final boss fight.

[h1]Mastery System[/h1]
For veteran players of Blaston, you may have everything unlocked, but for this one we wanted to continue to improve the introduction of the game for new players. Previously when you started the game, you unlocked weapons simply by leveling up. This was pretty arbitrary as you didn’t really know what was coming ahead of time, and you suddenly got new tools to use and had to figure it out by yourself.

With the new Mastery system, players will instead have the ability to track weapons to unlock them with weapon missions. At level 5, 10 and 15, new weapons will be available to be tracked. Players can go to the loadout to start tracking them and then complete the missions by playing the game. We’re hoping that this gives you a better start to the game where you learn things bit by bit.

[h1]Weapon Attachments[/h1]
This however leads to the new feature that you’re all waiting for, which are weapon attachments. When you’ve completed the weapon missions, weapons with attachments will have a new set of objectives for you to clear. The attachment missions will give you a chance to dig deeper into the mechanics of the weapon and learn it, before you expand on its mechanics.

Attachments give the player new possibilities to customize their loadout by altering the mechanics of the weapon, so be sure to check it out when Blaston: Reloaded releases.

[h1]Graphics Optimization[/h1]
As previously mentioned we’ve taken a thorough look at the game to see where we could improve and optimize the game. What will be most noticeable when you play the new update is that everything has a more clear and crisp look. This is because on a dev side we’ve gone through and improved how all the UI and how it's loaded in. The textures and player banners have all also been optimized from one of our technical artists, which should stabilize the framerate of the game on all platforms, so more smooth gameplay woho!

[h1]More Tweaks[/h1]
Finally, we’ve added some more tweaks that we think you’ll enjoy as well. Mission rewards in the next update will give you Blasts as rewards, but with the introduction of Legendary weapons and skins being added to the store. So if you missed out on those rewards previously, you’ll have your chance to get them in the next update. 

For the ranked mode, we’ve added a cooldown at the end and start of seasons to negate issues that some players had with their rank not being reset properly. We’re also adding the ability for players to make friendly lobbies with all seasonal modes. So now you can return to Quick Draw or Arctic Blast, whenever you like. We’ve also looked into fixing VFX for weapons and have been able to add a few news ones as well.

[h2]Get ready for the next update…[/h2]
With this we think you’re a bit more prepared for the gigantic update we have coming along for you, as we haven’t even shown you all the fixes or the new content yet. Now know you’re begging for the question of the release date of Blaston: Reloaded, and we will be posting that shortly, so make sure to [url=https://twitter.com/BlastonGame]follow us on Twitter[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.gg/Blaston]Blaston Discord[/url] to be the first to know when it happens.

notes.title: (April Fools!) Blaston: Redacted Update is live!
notes.content:
[b]We hope you enjoyed yesterday's April Fools with the Blaston: Redacted update! While this one was a joke, the very real Blaston: Reloaded update is coming along later this month.

Stay tuned for more info! 💥[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/c5dddd8d8feee2e528767c28ca49a7269760b297.png[/img]

We’re hitting you with a one-two punch of updates this month, and before the Blaston Reloaded update, we’re releasing the Blaston Redacted update! We’ve added a lot of community requested features and balancing to get you ready before all the attachments are added to the game.

[h2]New Feature: Machine Learning Bots[/h2]
We heard you, you want more difficult bots. We’ll you’re in for a treat, because we turned on machine learning on them, and to our surprise, these bots have gotten way out of control. For some reason, they all managed to get a hold of Blamos the camera hat, which lacks both a torso and hands. While we try to lock these bad bots down and give Clamos a stern talking to, queue up today and you might run into them!

[h2]New Seasonal Mode: Street Brawl[/h2]
In this new seasonal mode, players share a single platform and have no weapons but their fists and passionate spirit. The mode takes place in the Scrapper’s Street, and is perfect as a conclusion for your Discord trash talk.

[h2]New Feature: Podium Distance[/h2]
It’s time for us to be true to our community and include this into the patch notes. We’re documenting this from now on and we’ve moved the platforms 0.00000001 milimetres further away from each other for optimal gameplay.

[h2]New Feature: Lena Everywhere System[/h2]
Lena has gone rogue and will now start to appear where you least expect it, the main menu. In the crowd of matches, private Ozo Lounge lobbies, perhaps even in your living room. If she gets close enough to you, she will steal all of your tokens.
 	
[h2]New Weapon: Pebble[/h2]
You’ve mastered the FrostByte, now welcoming the Pebble! This little nasty rock has high projectile collision, will daze you on hit and may remind you of some horrible memories from elementary school.

[h2]New Collaboration Weapon: Holy Hand Grenade[/h2]
When we said “hit the mark” we weren’t fooling around. We’re bringing a classic to the world of Blaston. This nade has all of the nade components combined into a single weapon. This one has a 20 second cooldown, but upon detonation fires the Hammer, Nova, Majestic, Lance, Avalanche nade effects.

[h2]New Feature: Steve the intern[/h2]
We’ve recruited a new member to the team, Steve! Steve will hang out in the Ozo lounge at all times of the day to make you feel at home and also give you some life advice should you need it. We made sure to duck tape the VR headset to his head, locked him to a chair and put him in a storage room at the office. Enjoy this feature while he lasts!

[h2]Other Game Updates[/h2]
[list][*] Permanently removed all references to Jimboxx in the game.
[*] (Meta) Increased bHaptics haptic feedback by 9999%.
[*] “Entry of the Gladiators” will now start to play during matches when you juggle nades.
[*] To prevent players' pulses from going too high, we’ve changed the in-game music to calm ambient sounds for a relaxing experience.
[*] Queueing up for ranked now sends players into a dark void without any UI or music where they can reflect on their mistakes.[/list]

[h2]Weapon Updates[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Cortex Shield[/b]: Is now as wide as the platform that you stand on.
[*] [b]Aegis Shield[/b]: Increased health to 1000, decreased size by 90%.
[*] [b]Quicksilver[/b]: Doubled the boost speed, is now activated by grabbing with both hands.
[*] [b]Tundra[/b]: Hitting a player with a Tundra projectile will now freeze the opponents game to make them crash and give you an instant win.
[*] [b]Nova Helix[/b]: Reverted balance to the release version of the weapon.
[*] [b]Vandal[/b]: Cloud projectile now destroys held weapons.
[*] [b]Bunker Barrier[/b]: Now lasts 0.428 seconds longer.[/list]

[h2]Ozo Lounge Updates[/h2]
[list][*] Gave the bartender a Hammer which is used on players whenever a glass is thrown their way. Players hit by the hammer will be sent back to the main menu.
[*] On Fridays, Ozo the bear will now appear in the Disco to DJ some banging beats.[/list]

[h2]Ranked Changes[/h2]
[list][*] Fist bumping your opponent after a match now gives players extra LP.
[*] Doing inappropriate gestures after a match now makes players lose extra LP.[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed server boosting so that it now only affects players with high speed internet connection.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed your high score in the Zombies on the Dance Floor arcade machine to give you an edge in duels.[/list]

notes.title: Blaston: Reloaded Update Devlog #1 - Community Requested Features
notes.content:
Hi there Blasters! Today we wanted to share some information on the upcoming Blaston update, Blaston: Reloaded (scheduled for April), in our first devlog video with our Community Manager! Watch the video below to get the information, or read the text version here below.

[previewyoutube=ue8izk4Qwnw;full][/previewyoutube]

Earlier this year we talked briefly about it in our roadmap video, and we’re finally getting close. While everything isn’t really ready to be shown just yet, we wanted to let you in and update you on some of the features that we’ve been working on, that have been requested by the community. So strap in because we’re about to go super nerdy on this one.

[h2]Requested Feature: Waiting for an Opponent[/h2]
We know a lot of people have been asking for the ability to interact with the main menu while queuing. In the update, we’re adding this and calling it “[b]Wait for an Opponent[/b]”. When this is enabled, you’ll still be able to interact with the store and your loadout, and practice those ellipse curves while you’re at it.

[h2]Requested Feature: Ranked & Bot Changes
[/h2]Late last year we introduced rank decay and no more League points gained by bots. While this did make for a more competitive format, we felt in hindsight that we were removing the “Never Stay Still” aspect as we made facing bots less attractive. In the new update, we’re bringing bot rewards back, but slightly more balanced. We’re also looking into improving the bots a bit, and making them a bit more challenging for those in the Overlord league.

[h2]Requested Features: Match Ping Indicators
[/h2]Another visual change that is coming in Blaston Reloaded is the introduction of [b]Ping Indicators[/b]. These are shown by the health bars during matches, and let you know the status of both you and your opponents’ network connection to the match. We hope that this will allow you to more easily identify your own issues when they arise during matches. We’re also hoping that this will make it easier for online tournament organizers to run their tournaments.

[h2]Requested Features: Projectile Speeds
[/h2]Finally, in the Blaston: Reloaded update, we’re changing all weapon projectiles to have a [b]linear travel speed[/b], instead of an [b]initial burst that slows down[/b]. Currently in the game, and how it’s been since launch, projectiles are shot out from the weapon with a burst of speed to then slow down when traveling towards your opponent. We also played the game a lot in good conditions.

As you know, we didn’t anticipate Blaston to become so competitive focused at release, and with a lot of things going online the last few years, we’ve come to see the drawbacks of having this cool looking burst in suboptimal network conditions. During those times, it sometimes appears as projectiles are spawning further ahead when players experience lag.

So what does this change mean? Well with this change, hopefully you’ll have a more smooth experience when playing Blaston - and projectiles won’t appear to pop out unexpectedly as much anymore.

[h2]In the next devlog
[/h2]
Overall, besides all of the exciting new content we have planned for this update, we’re taking a thorough look at Blaston from the ground up, to give you the best possible experience when playing. In the next dev log, we’ll take a closer look at Quality of Life improvements that we’ve added to the game since December.

We hope that you’re excited as we are for Blaston: Reloaded, and we'll see you in the next devlog!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/9b5ef0008daff305b1b5846dab7eb8da4e909022.png[/img]

It’s time to [i]freeze[/i] the day, and join in on the new seasonal update, presenting the Arctic Blast Update! In version 1.14 we’ve continued to expand the game by adding a new floor to the Ozo Lounge, a new arena, weapon, as well as cosmetics, and of course a new Seasonal Mode - [b]Arctic Blast[/b]! [i]Cool[/i] down, and load into a game on the Arctic Resort where you’ll pick up weapons from a surprise loadout before all [i]hail[/i] breaks loose!

[h1]New Game Mode: Arctic Blast[/h1]
Surprise loadouts! When playing in the Arctic Blast mode, players will play on the Arctic Resort with randomly selected loadouts that are not bound by normal rules. Will the next game be a complete snowball war? Or will you get a visit from the Nova family? Find out in the new seasonal mode!

[h1]New Ozo Lounge Floor: Knockout![/h1]
The Ozo Lounge has opened up a new floor, welcome to Knockout! Here up to 8 players will be able to host and organize single elimination tournaments to find out who’s the best player in the room! Besides playing, you’ll be able to watch the games live and go back to watch replays of other matches. The winner will be able to pick up a Trophy and showcase their victory to the rest. The room will also allow for a 9th player to join in for those times when an organizer would like to check in on the tournament!

[h1]New Rewards: FrostSpyke & Glacial Peak[/h1]
Of course, we’re adding more Mission rewards. This time we’re going full-on with the winter theme and we have added a new FrostByte skin - the sporty FrostSpyke! We’re also introducing the first legendary platform with the ice pillar Glacial Peak! Make sure to complete the missions to unlock the rewards!

[h1]New Weapon: Tundra[/h1]
A new weapon and mechanic has joined the fray! With the Tundra, you shoot out a large icicle at your opponents. If your opponent gets hit by it, their vision will freeze and they’ll have a tough time seeing what they should dodge! Hit more times and the effect will stack for even less vision!

[h1]New Avatar: Shoxx[/h1]
[i]A new face joins the fray. Always a reckless lone-wolf, even before he got banned by b0yk0t. For a long time, he kept to himself, but Aranex invited him to NeoTexx, for some reason.[/i] Shoxx sports a hologram face, which changes and reacts to the gameplay in Blaston. The avatar of Shoxx is now available in the store.

[h1]New Arena: Arctic Resort[/h1]
We’ve heard the calls from our previous update, and this time we’re making the seasonal mode arena available in the store so that you can enjoy and play on it in regular duels as well!

[i]As a way of protesting against Omnico, one of the most popular vacation spots was replicated; The Arctic Resort. Acting as a protest against the state of the world and Omnico itself, this version has a harsher environment with bits and pieces from Blaston world featured in it.[/i]

[h1]New Game Mode: Quick Draw[/h1]
You can now play in the seasonal mode queue! The first seasonal mode we’re introducing is [b]Quick Draw[/b]! Face off in the Greatstone Valley, far away from the city you know and love, and duel each other in old school fashion! Both players play using the [b]Deadringer[/b], a legendary skin for the Raptor which in this mode is sped up to replicate a more realistic cowboy duel! Finish the missions and collect the premium rewards that you get to try out in the Quick Draw mode! Play as the newest character [b]Taylock[/b], who represents the TrueTech faction along with the Legendary Raptor skin, the [b]Deadringer[/b].

notes.title: Blaston Crackdown Update is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/c92aeb2d7a8a9d514a540f8c9884a1b616ec25e2.png[/img]

[h1]The Blaston Crackdown Update is now live![/h1]

It’s time to get back into Blaston with the biggest update yet! The world of Blaston has grown, and with it, new challengers have appeared to take down the duelists! In this update we’re introducing:

[b]A new single-player campaign[/b]: The Octopresence have invaded the underground world of Blaston dueling with Octo Agents. Some duelists have reportedly been hacked by an unknown entity called ModOps. It’s time to take them on and find out more about why and who is behind it all!

[b]New battle arena[/b]: Finish the campaign and unlock the new arena Scrapper’s Market in the store to battle opponents in a new environment.

[b]New avatar & skins[/b]: Play through the campaign and unlock the ModOps skins in the store! We’ve also added the Octo Agent and the legendary Viper Ellipse as Mission Rewards.

[b]Upgraded Ozo Lounge[/b]: The social space for Blaston has been upgraded and expanded! There are now Tokens to be used in the Ozo Lounge to play improved versions of the arcade game Alien Blast (now called Super Alien Blast), and a jukebox has been added to Disco 99!

[b]bHaptics Integration for Oculus[/b]: Want to fully experience the rush of playing Blaston? Well, now you can by using bHaptics vests. Now you can wear one while playing Blaston on Oculus, and take your gameplay to the next level. Pinpoint where you get hit and get more instant feedback during your matches!

[h2]Game Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] New single-player campaign added: The Crackdown
[*] New battle arena added: Scrapper’s Market
[*] Mission Reward added: Octo Agent
[*] Mission Reward added: Legendary Viper Ellipse
[*] Story Reward added: ModOps Skins for Dracx, Scrofax, Squillax & Taurex
[*] Oculus bHaptics support & integration implemented
[*] Added player warnings: Players who break rules or our code of conduct will now first get a warning before any subsequent bans are given out
[*] Added connection warning when the player network is unstable
[*] Added UI Improvements to the mission screen
[/list]

[h2]Weapon Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] All weapon projectiles collision detection has been improved. 
[*] [b]Nova[/b]: Reload time has been reduced 1.5s to 1s.
[*] [b]Viper Ellipse[/b]: Speed increased from 2.85 to 3, Ammo reduced from 4 to 3, spawn cost reduced from 7s to 6s.
[*] [b]Viper[/b]: Reload time decreased from 2s to 1.5s.
[*] [b]Quicksilver[/b]: Damage taken on early break reduced from 10HP to 5HP.
[*] [b]Hammer[/b]: Reload time decreased from 1s to 0.5s.
[*] [b]Raptor[/b]: Ammo increased from 5 to 6, Damage decreased from 10 to 8.
[*] [b]Frostbyte[/b]: Max throw speed reduced from 4.8 to 4.5
[*] [b]Vandal[/b]: Cloud reduced in size
[/list]

[h2]Ozo Lounge Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ozo Lounge Tokens added
[*] Character “Lena” added to the Back Alley
[*] Jukebox added to the Disco 99 floor
[*] Upgraded the arcade game “Super Alien Blast”
[*] Remote grabbing of objects added
[*] Tutorial added to the Back Alley
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed most instances where projectiles would pass through other objects.*
[*] Fixed issue where projectiles damaged players twice.
[*] Fixed issue where the profile icon didn’t match the avatar in the match.
[*] Fixed unlocked tool items showed locked icons when owned.
[*] General performance optimizations.
[*] Oculus party voice is now prioritized over in-game voice in friendly matches.
[*] Improved the hitbox of the Frostbyte.
[*] Fixed issue where the Frostbyte would collide with projectiles twice.
[*] Fixed issue where there would be a lag at the end of a replay.
[/list]

[i]* = There can still be cases if a shield is moved rapidly, the projectiles may pass through. If you notice any instances of this we urge you to please report it! [/i]
 
Make sure to join the Blaston Community on [url=https://discord.gg/Blaston]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BlastonGame]Twitter[/url] for future updates!
 
See you out there in the arenas!
 
The Blaston Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/f73e7fdb10fee7c386ac353af7d14fd9e33b57c8.png[/img]

Salutations, Blasters! We’re happy to be back with the first update of the year and we’ve got some good stuff packed into this one, including new game mode, an upcoming tournament mode, character skins and more!

We hope you enjoy these updates and see you in the arena!
[i]- The Blaston Team[/i]
